column1: # Lucene 10.5.0 lucene-core: every top-level class of the jar, and what became of it.
# Checked by scripts/check-port-inventory.py (see its docstring for the statuses).

column3: Base class of the SPI name-based factory plumbing (Solr/CustomAnalyzer configuration); Rust composes analyzers directly in code.
JVM ServiceLoader lookup of analysis factories by name; no Rust equivalent needed.
